Manage external agent plugins

Usage:
  trace plugin [command]

Available Commands:
  install     Download and install a plugin
  list        List installed plugins and their capabilities
  remove      Remove an installed plugin
  search      Search available plugins in the registry

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for plugin

Global Flags:
  -c, --config string   path to config file

Use "trace plugin [command] --help" for more information about a command.
